_note: B6 no-model half of the third coverage gap: host getSortedEntries scans an owned synthetic book with before/after, constant and disabled entries. Setting-off control, late-depth treatment and unchanged server file. R7 same-speaker cache reuse and F29 payload captures remain separate measurements.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s = rt.getGlobalSettings(); if (s.image.enabled || s.sprites.enabled) throw new Error('media must be off'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const book = 'SO-V28-35 Placement Lore'; if (wi.world_names.includes(book)) throw new Error('fixture book already exists'); await wi.createNewWorldInfo(book); const data = { entries: Object.fromEntries([['Before', 0, false, false], ['After', 1, false, false], ['Constant', 1, true, false], ['Disabled', 1, false, true]].map(([comment, position, constant, disable], uid) => [uid, { uid, comment, key: ['beacon'], keysecondary: [], content: 'SO-B6-' + comment, position, depth: 2, role: 1, order: 100 - uid, constant, disable, selective: false, selectiveLogic: 0, probability: 100, useProbability: true }])) }; await wi.saveWorldInfo(book, data, true); wi.worldInfoCache.delete(book); globalThis.__b6placement = { book, disk: async () => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const response = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: book }), cache: 'no-cache' }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('book read failed: ' + response.status); return JSON.stringify((await response.json()).entries); }, scan: async () => (await wi.getSortedEntries()).filter((e) => e.world === book).map((e) => ({ comment: e.comment, position: e.position, depth: e.depth, role: e.role, disable: e.disable, content: e.content })) }; globalThis.__b6placement.before = await globalThis.__b6placement.disk(); return { mediaOff: true, entries: 4 };

const b = globalThis.__b6placement; const rows = await b.scan(); if (rows.length !== 4) throw new Error('owned story entries absent or duplicated: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); for (const row of rows) if (row.position !== (row.comment === 'Before' ? 0 : 1) || row.depth !== 2 || row.role !== 1) throw new Error('off control moved entry: ' + JSON.stringify(row)); b.control = rows; const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.worldInfo.lateLore = true; return { control: rows };

const b = globalThis.__b6placement; const rows = await b.scan(); if (rows.length !== 4) throw new Error('treatment denominator changed'); for (const row of rows) { if (row.comment === 'Before' || row.comment === 'After') { const depth = row.comment === 'Before' ? 5 : 4; if (row.position !== 4 || row.depth !== depth || row.role !== 0) throw new Error('late placement not applied: ' + JSON.stringify(row)); } else { const control = b.control.find((e) => e.comment === row.comment); if (JSON.stringify(row) !== JSON.stringify(control)) throw new Error('constant or disabled entry moved: ' + JSON.stringify(row)); } } if (await b.disk() !== b.before) throw new Error('placement wrote the server file'); if (JSON.stringify(await b.scan()) !== JSON.stringify(rows)) throw new Error('repeated scan is unstable'); return { treatment: rows, unchangedDisk: true, repeatEqual: true };
